hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/src/*.rs) jq -n --arg r "${f#"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/}" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("Tutorial sync: you changed " + $r + ". Before you finish, update every docs/tutorial page whose [pages.*] sources in docs/tutorial/sources.toml list this file or one of its parent directories, bump that page footer date, and run cargo test --test tutorial_map (rules: docs/tutorial/AUTHORING.md).")}}' ;; esac
